comment: The Lominsan Way's quest battle (59): the NPC the player protects (BNpcBase 1771, BNpcName 2075, layout 4295472; battalion 5): level 30, 2418 HP; the battle is lost when it falls. It never moved or acted in seven runs (Bob's Chronofoil captures 44df02fc (2026-11-03, six runs, the last won) and c9145fdc (2026-11-03, one run, won), `questkit chronofoil --battle`; a level 34-35 player): the director holds it.
